## 📋 Description of Changes
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## 🔍 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Code style / Refactor / Performance improvement

## 🧪 Testing Performed
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Local dev build (`npm run dev`) verified in browser
- [ ] Production build succeeds without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Docker Compose startup verified (`docker compose up -d`)
- [ ] WebSockets / RTMP streaming functionality confirmed

Add before/after screenshots or recordings here.
